## dh pr create {#dh-pr-create}

Create a review for café data.

Use --json with a comma-separated list of fields for structured output. --jq and --template transform the selected JSON and require --json.

Aliases: add, new.

### Usage

```text
dh pr create NAME [flags]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Optional | Repeated | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>NAME</code> | false | false | Name to create |

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>--body</code> | <code>-b</code> | string | <code>"a&#124;b&#92;n&#96;quoted&#96;"</code> | Text with &#124;, &#96;code&#96;, &lt;html&gt;, &amp; and &#91;links&#93; |
| <code>--help</code> | <code>-h</code> | bool | <code>false</code> | help for create |
| <code>--host</code> |  | string | <code>"local.test"</code> | Overrides inherited host |
| <code>--jq</code> |  | string | <code>""</code> | Filter JSON output using a jq &#96;expression&#96; |
| <code>--json</code> |  | stringSlice | <code>&#91;&#93;</code> | Output JSON with the specified &#96;fields&#96; |
| <code>--legacy</code> |  | bool | <code>false</code> | Old flag Deprecated: use body |
| <code>--template</code> |  | string | <code>""</code> | Format JSON output using a Go template |

### Structured

Selected fields.

JSON fields: <code>id</code>.

### JSON fields

<code>id</code>, <code>title</code>

### Output

Prints the review.
